Office and logistics vacancy report, 2026

National office vacancy reached 19.6% in 2026. Logistics vacancy rose to 7.3% in 2026 as new supply arrived. Waterfront office vacancy was lower, at 14.2% in 2026.

Net absorption turned positive for logistics space in the third quarter, led by third-party operators.

This fictional report was prepared for a software demonstration.
